info.name: DevReview API
info.description:
Complete endpoint coverage for the DevReview backend (39 endpoints).

Run order is significant: the Auth folder logs in as admin, reviewer and student; later folders chain created resource IDs (submissionId, assignmentId, notificationId, auditId) through test scripts.
